summary.text: Pam Lanman Guzzone is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 13 who has served since January 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Guzzone was born in Massachusetts and lives in Maryland.

She earned a bachelor's degree in political science and government from Tufts University in 1985 and a master's degree in national security policy studies from the University of Maryland School of Public Policy in 1989.
Her career experience includes founding her own business and working as a manager of operations at the NASA Goddard Space Flight Center.
Guzzone succeeded Shane Pendergrass in the House of Delegates and advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignment for 2025-2026 as the Health and Government Operations Committee.
